dates.text: idus octobris anno à nativitate et consurra Domini millesimo quarringentesimo quadragesimo quarto

data.summary: Felix V, Bishop of Geneva, commits the administration of the Hospital of the Little Smiths and its chapel to Johannes, Prior of Saint Helena, following the death of the previous rector, and grants him the right to retain the benefice.
